posts.cooked:
Hi,

I was solving ppa_4.2 on the vm I am getting error while evaluating it. some test cases are passing some are not while fixing it. I have conclude that Pincode_info.csv file has issue which is input file to pincode.sh script file. I have find that there is one more script is in this folder which is script.sh which is shown in screen shot. I have question that why it is appeared in this folder.

I have attached two screenshot one problem and other with solution script and test cases failing.

Please let me know solution for same

posts.cooked:
The script.sh is used to run your pincode.sh script, you need not worry about that.

You can see the solution of this question here.
